Definition
[$\kappa $-solution with Harnack] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0109, page-0110 ↗ def:chow-iii-kappa-solution 1. ch19:19.27\group Harnack

Replace the bounded-curvature clause in Definition 1 by Hamilton's trace Harnack inequality \[ \partial _tR+2\langle \nabla R,X\rangle +2\Rc (X,X)\ge 0 \] for every vector field $X$. Taking $X=0$ shows that $R$ is nondecreasing in time; an unbounded such solution has $\operatorname {ASCR}=\infty $.
